panels.description: Minden év az aktuális év naptárára vetítve - évfüggetlen. Színskála: sötétszürke (régi) → kék (új) évtizedenként; narancs = tavalyi, vastag piros = idei; sötétpiros szaggatott = Hydroinfo előrejelzés. Piros vonal: LNV 845 cm.

targets.rawSql: SELECT make_date(extract(year FROM now())::int, extract(month FROM day_local)::int, extract(day FROM day_local)::int)::timestamptz AS "time", CASE WHEN extract(year FROM day_local) = extract(year FROM now()) THEN 'idei (' || extract(year FROM day_local)::int::text || ')' WHEN extract(year FROM day_local) = extract(year FROM now()) - 1 THEN 'tavalyi (' || extract(year FROM day_local)::int::text || ')' ELSE extract(year FROM day_local)::text END AS metric, mean_cm FROM daily_aggregates WHERE station_tsz = 5 AND NOT (extract(month FROM day_local) = 2 AND extract(day FROM day_local) = 29 AND NOT ((extract(year FROM now())::int % 4 = 0 AND extract(year FROM now())::int % 100 <> 0) OR extract(year FROM now())::int % 400 = 0)) ORDER BY 1

SELECT make_date(extract(year FROM now())::int, extract(month FROM day_local)::int, extract(day FROM day_local)::int)::timestamptz AS "time", mean_cm AS "előrejelzés" FROM daily_aggregates WHERE station_tsz = 5 AND day_local = (SELECT max(day_local) FROM daily_aggregates WHERE station_tsz = 5) UNION ALL SELECT make_date(extract(year FROM now())::int, extract(month FROM (target_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest'))::int, extract(day FROM (target_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest'))::int)::timestamptz, round(avg(value_cm), 1) FROM forecast_points WHERE point_type = 'forecast' AND (target_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Budapest')::date > (SELECT max(day_local) FROM daily_aggregates WHERE station_tsz = 5) AND run_id = (SELECT id FROM forecast_runs WHERE station_code = '442522H' ORDER BY issue_ts DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
